o.text: From Arabic حَرَكَات (ḥarakāt), plural of حَرَكَة (ḥaraka), whence Azerbaijani hərəkət (“movement, action”).
Borrowed from Arabic حَادِثَة (ḥādiṯa). Compare Turkish hadise.
